segments.ja455:1.1: Tassa nāgassa vippavāsena, virūḷhā sallakī ca kuṭajā ca;
segments.ja455:1.3: Kuruvindakaravīrā [karavarā (sī. syā.)] tisasāmā ca, nivāte pupphitā ca kaṇikārā.
segments.ja455:2.3: Yattha rājā rājakumāro vā, kavacamabhihessati achambhito [asambhīto (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja455:3.1: Gaṇhāhi nāga kabaḷaṃ, mā nāga kisako bhava;
segments.ja455:3.3: Bahūni rājakiccāni, tāni [yāni (sī. pī.)] nāga karissasi.
segments.ja455:4.3: Khāṇuṃ pādena ghaṭṭeti, giriṃ caṇḍoraṇaṃ pati.
segments.ja455:5.1: Kā nu te sā mahānāga, andhā apariṇāyikā;
segments.ja455:5.3: Khāṇuṃ pādena ghaṭṭeti, giriṃ caṇḍoraṇaṃ pati.
segments.ja455:6.1: Mātā me sā mahārāja, andhā apariṇāyikā;
segments.ja455:6.3: Khāṇuṃ pādena ghaṭṭeti, giriṃ caṇḍoraṇaṃ pati.
segments.ja455:7.3: Sametu mātarā nāgo, saha sabbehi ñātibhi.
segments.ja455:8.1: Mutto ca bandhanā nāgo, muttamādāya kuñjaro [kāsirājena pesito (sī. syā.), mutto dāmāto kuñjaro (pī. sī. niyya)];
segments.ja455:9.1: Tato so naḷiniṃ [nilinaṃ (syā.)] gantvā, sītaṃ kuñjarasevitaṃ;
segments.ja455:10.1: Koya anariyo devo, akālenapi vassati [akālena pavassati (sī. syā.), akālena’ tivassati (pī.)];
segments.ja455:10.3: Gato me atrajo putto, yo mayhaṃ paricārako.
segments.ja455:11.1: Uṭṭhehi amma kiṃ sesi, āgato tyāhamatrajo;
segments.ja455:12.1: Ciraṃ jīvatu so rājā, kāsīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhano;
segments.ja455:12.3: Yo me puttaṃ pamocesi, sadā vuddhāpacāyikanti.
